places.name: Stanley Park
places.ai_summary: Stanley Park is a world-renowned urban park featuring scenic trails, beaches, and the Vancouver Seawall.

places.ai_summary: Granville Island is a vibrant cultural district featuring markets, artisan shops, and waterfront dining.

places.name: Grouse Mountain
places.ai_summary: Grouse Mountain is a popular year-round destination for outdoor activities, offering skiing, snowboarding, hiking, and stunning views of Vancouver.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops and restaurants may have extended hours.
